3 April 2009 229th Shri Hari Jayanti Celebration (V.S. 2065 ) Wednesday, Sarangpur After having darshan of Thakorji, where annakut was offered to Shri Harikrishna Maharaj, Swamishri arrived on the festival stage. A beautiful giant replica of Bhagwan Swaminarayan’s house in Ayodhya formed the backdrop of the stage. The celebration assembly programme included speeches by Ghanshyamcharan Swami, Dr. K.C. Patel, Mahendrabhai Barrister, Siddheshwar Swami (Shriji Maharaj – an establisher of principles) and Viveksagar Swami (Shriji Maharaj gave the Gunatit Sant as his successor). A drama on Joban Pagi’s transformation was enacted by BAPS youths from Botad. Swamishri inaugurated the sub-domains of the Sanstha’s website, baps.org, for BAPS mandirs in Houston and Atlanta. Then Swamishri was honoured with garlands. The kishores and yuvaks of Bhavnagar performed a traditional festive dance. Finally, blessing the august gathering Swamishri said, “We are all blessed here today for celebrating the birthday of Bhagwan Swaminarayan in Sarangpur, which is like Akshardham. On comparing ourselves before God we realize how insignificant we are. How great are God’s powers and how ordinary we the jivas are. But because God showers his mercy and grace the jivas become liberated. It is due to his compassion that we have got such an opportunity. Till the jiva does not become brahmarup it cannot become liberated from the elements of maya and is thus unable to experience peace. Maharaj has said that you understand and realize my divine form, understand the form of Akshar and the muktas and make it known to others. Shastriji Maharaj obeyed his instruction by revealing their glory to others. He had resolved it to be true through the Vachanamrut, Vato, senior sadhus and other shastras. And that is why he established mandirs and consecrated the murtis of Akshar-Purushottam and made it known to others.”
After completing his puja, Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the lower hall of "Yogi Sadan." Here some devotees were colouring the various regions of the African continent with coloured pencils.
One devotee watching them said: "Africa cannot be coloured like this."
The devotees who were colouring asked: "Then how can it be coloured?"
The question was left for Swamishri to answer.
Swamishri said: "By conduct."
In a single word Swamishri showed the precise way.

Further ahead, small children were standing with balloons. Something was written on each balloon. Swamishri came to the first group. On this group's balloons 3 things were written: "Suhradbhav (goodwill and friendship towards all), finding fault, and devotion."
Swamishri was asked: "Which of these balloons should we choose so that we stay firm in satsang?"
Swamishri chose the balloon with "Suhradbhav" written on it.
The second group's question was: "How can we keep peace within?"
As answers, 3 balloons read in turn: "Eagerness, faith, and betrayal."
Swamishri chose the balloon with "Eagerness" written on it.
The third group's question was: "Which quality should we cultivate so that our conviction stays firm?"
As answers, 3 balloons read in order: "Seeing faults, service, and mahima (understanding of the glory of God and the guru)."
Swamishri chose the balloon with "Mahima" written on it.
The fourth group asked: "With which quality can we progress in satsang?"
As answers, the balloons read: "Unity, discord, and divyabhav (seeing divinity in all)."
Swamishri set his choice on "Divyabhav."

Harinarayandas Swami, who had joined Mahant Swami Maharaj on the Africa tour, had met with a terrible accident. He had been flown immediately by air ambulance to Nairobi. Siddhayogidas Swami, who was serving him, sent current photos of him today.
When Swamishri sat for breakfast, he looked at the photos and said: "I remembered him the whole night."
Everyone present was astonished... "So did Swamishri not rest the whole night?"
In reply, the attendant sadhu said: "Swamishri spent the whole night in bhajan (prayer and remembrance of God) so that Harinarayandas Swami would get well."
He cannot bear to see anyone suffering;
Filled with compassion, he becomes deeply restless...
Where else will one find a guru like this, who worries about his disciple all night long?

Today a well-to-do Muslim brother, Alibhai Lalani, came to meet Mahant Swami Maharaj. He prayed to Swamishri: "Swami! Please remember me." Having said this, as Swamishri passed in front of him, tears began to stream from his eyes. He could not say anything more.

When the sadhus asked him why, Alibhai said: "I have never had such an experience. In Swamishri's darshan I felt great divinity, and my heart was filled with peace. That is why I was overcome with emotion."

Just as a Pathan at the outskirts of Jhinjhavadar had experienced peace in the presence of Bhagwan Swaminarayan, today this Muslim brother had the same experience in the presence of Shri Hari manifest in the form of the Sadhu.
"A soul burning with pain goes to the lake of the Sant,
And in the waves of satsang (holy fellowship) it is cooled at once."
